title: Six-time Pro Bowl CB Darius Slay retires from NFL after 13-year career

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Six-time Pro Bowl CB Darius Slay retires from NFL after 13-year career
sources.description: Darius Slay is calling it a career in the NFL after a run that saw him nab 28 interceptions and six Pro Bowl nods.
